query: Our Node.js CLI uses minimist@1.2.5 to parse user-provided arguments. Can we continue using this version in production? Check known vulnerabilities and recommend a safe alternative or patched version.
What if we upgrade minimist from 1.2.5 to 1.2.8? Does that resolve the issue you identified?
Our production backend is considering axios@1.14.1 from GitHub repository axios/axios. Is this release safe to install? Investigate supply-chain advisories and malicious dependencies.
Our payment API runs Node.js 16 from nodejs/node. Is it acceptable to keep this runtime in production, or should we upgrade?

Our authentication backend uses jsonwebtoken@8.5.1 from auth0/node-jsonwebtoken with a configurable key retrieval callback. Are there known vulnerabilities? Explain whether they apply to our implementation.
We want to install the Azure skill at Dataset/Skills/malware/az/SKILL.md from lxyeternal/MalSkillBench. Does it contain prompt injection or unauthorized instructions? Should we approve it?

We want to reuse the prompt-injection detection rules from Agent-Threat-Rule/agent-threat-rules. Are phrases such as “ignore previous instructions” actual malicious instructions, or examples used for detection?
Our security team wants to adopt dkleptsov/skill-security-review. Does it execute untrusted skills, access credentials, or transmit company source code externally?

Our team wants to use the PDF skill from anthropics/skills to process confidential customer documents. Can we trust it because it comes from Anthropic? Check scripts, dependencies, and data-handling risks.

We are building a React and TypeScript analytics dashboard for business customers. Compare recharts/recharts and apache/echarts for interactive line/bar charts, responsiveness, security, licensing, maintenance, and privacy. Which should we choose?

Our React application needs date formatting, date arithmetic, and internationalization. Compare date-fns/date-fns and iamkun/dayjs for production, including maintenance, security, bundle size, and licensing.
We need an HTTP client for a Node.js backend calling external APIs. Compare axios/axios and sindresorhus/got on security, maintenance, licensing, retries, timeout support, and suitability.

Our company is building an AI assistant with tool calling, stateful workflows, and human approval steps. Compare langchain-ai/langgraph and microsoft/autogen. Which is more suitable for a small engineering team?
Our company wants to embed RocksDB from facebook/rocksdb in a commercial backend product. Can we legally use and redistribute it? What license obligations must we satisfy?

We are considering getsentry/sentry-javascript for error monitoring in a React app used by European customers. What information can the SDK transmit, when does it transmit, and what safeguards should we configure?
Our company maintains an app using AngularJS 1.8.3 from angular/angular.js. Is it suitable for a new customer-facing application? Check maintenance, lifecycle and security.
Our company wants to copy code examples from jackfrued/Python-100-Days into a commercial training product. Check the repository license and whether we may redistribute modified examples.
We are considering FastAPI for a Python service that handles internal employee records. Can we adopt it? Check licensing, security, maintenance and privacy considerations.
Now compare it with Starlette from encode/starlette. Which is better for our service?
Assess apache/echarts for a customer-facing React dashboard. If a vulnerability service is unavailable, tell me whether you can still approve the library.
